_comment: Hand-built test data, not a capture of the live server.
Eight FARPs chosen to exercise the shortname rules (HAWK fits as-is,
WHIRLWIND needs the WH digraph, STONEBRIDGE needs DG, VINTOKRYL needs the
Y fallback, NEW HOPE has a space, RHODESIA collides with RHODES), two UTM
zones, a Needs Repair status, and every kind of marker the parser has to
ignore. The three spawn points sit exactly 100 m west of their FARP
marker, which is the offset the generator corrects for.
